title: Spiced Sweet Potato Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Roasted sweet potato and warm spices whisked into a brown sugar milk custard, with the cream added cold.
summary: A take on our classic custard built on milk, with roasted sweet potato and warm spices whisked in and the cream added cold. Earthy, spiced and smooth.

ingredients.note: gives about 250 g flesh; nutrition counts the flesh

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Prick the sweet potatoes with the fork and roast on the tray for 45-60 min until very soft. Cool, peel, blend the flesh until smooth, press through the sieve and weigh out 250 g.

steps.title: Spice the yolks
steps.text: Whisk the yolks with the brown sugar, salt and spices.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming and whisk it slowly into the yolks, then return to the pan.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir over a gentle heat until the spiced custard reaches 77-80 °C and lightly coats the back of the spatula.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Off the heat, whisk in the sweet potato. Cool in the iced water, then stir in the cream and vanilla and chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn, then freeze for at least 4 h.

tips: Orange-fleshed sweet potatoes give the best colour and flavour.
A common mistake is skipping the sieve, which leaves stringy fibres.
Use any spare purée in soups or mash.
storage: Freeze, covered, for up to 2 weeks.
